description: The counties (with parcel and building counts), entity registries, and crosswalk systems this FactLot Registry file holds, each with its sources and as-of dates. Call it before concluding that a parcel or entity does not exist: a miss outside these regions means not loaded, not absent. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).
